title: This Drone Fires Its Own Missiles

lines.text: A normal fighter has to fly close enough for the enemy to shoot back.
So what if it never had to get close at all?
An F-15 carries it under its wing, far from the fight.
Then it lets go, and the drone falls like a bomb.
Its wings swing out. Its jet engine lights.
And it flies ahead on its own, toward a fight the pilot never has to enter.
But the strangest part is what it keeps inside its belly.
The doors open, the missiles drop clear, and their motors light.
Meanwhile the fighter that launched it turns for home, untouched.
Wind tunnel testing is done. Flight testing could start as soon as late this year.
Follow for more machines that change the fight.
